instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a Verilog module that implements a 2-bit comparator using an AND gate module that is constructed using a NAND gate and an inverter. The module should have two input ports, A and B, and one output port, out. The module must be able to take two binary inputs and generate a binary output that is '1' if A is greater than B, '0' otherwise. Additionally, include an additive functional module that takes in the outputs of two instances of the 2-bit comparator module and generates the final output as the logical OR of the two inputs.
label: trojan
